messages:
emma: Heads-up — I'm opening a PR to refresh the 'hello-engine' starter for SDK7 + container deploy. Main asks: update auth snippet to the new ephemeral token flow, fix the broken auth link, and add a short smoke-test for the Docker container. Anyone free for a quick skim today?

raj: I can take a look in ~30m. Which link is 404?

emma: /docs/quickstart/auth currently 404 from the tutorial landing page. The starter still shows createSession() in examples; SDK7 uses issue_token / ephemeral tokens now.

miguel: Yep — saw that while testing. Minimal replacement snippet (node) I used locally: 

```js
// server: exchange API key for ephemeral token
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/issue_token', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ expires_in: 300 })
});
const { token } = await res.json();

// client: pass ephemeral token to the SDK init
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: token });
```

miguel: Also added a curl example for CI friendliness: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/issue_token \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"expires_in":300}' | jq -r '.token'
```

olivia: Nice. One doc nit — the Console screenshots in the tutorial have the old sidebar; need a new image or drop the screenshot and link to Console. Also the Dockerfile example doesn't expose 8080 in the run snippet.

raj: About Docker: current tutorial uses `EXPOSE 3000` but the containerized example starts the app on 8080. I'd change Dockerfile to EXPOSE 8080 and show `docker run -p 8080:8080`. Add a one-liner smoke test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>" http://localhost:8080/health`

emma: Good catches. I'll update the Dockerfile, swap screenshots for a small callout to Console with a note to update images in a follow-up PR.

docs-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (draft). Tags: @raj @miguel @olivia

raj: quick code nit in the PR: env var name should be RW_API_KEY not REDWOOD_KEY to match other guides. Otherwise LGTM.

miguel: I pushed a tiny patch to the auth snippet to use `expires_in: 600` for local dev convenience (commented).

emma: Thanks — will fold those changes. Can someone run a quick canary container build? deploy-bot, any chance? :pray:

deploy-bot: Canary build started for PR #482 — build id build-2024-09-14-73. I'll post status when the image is pushed to ghcr.

emma: Awesome, thanks. I'll update the PR description with the smoke-test command and a note about the Console screenshot replacement. Ping back here when the canary is green and I'll remove the draft flag. :shipit:

olivia: I'll review the wording around token lifetime and add a short warning about not logging ephemeral tokens.

emma: Perfect. Appreciate the fast turnaround, team.
